name: The Gatsbyhouse
address: 48 Beer St, Rosemore, George, 6529, South Africa
description_short: Authentic Gatsby heaven in George serving generous portions of Cape Town's iconic street food classic.
description_long:
The Gatsbyhouse brings Cape Town's legendary street food to George, serving up proper Gatsbys piled high with chips, steak, chicken, or veg and all the traditional trimmings. Located on Beer Street in Rosemore, this spot delivers the real deal – no shortcuts, just honest portions that'll sort you out whether you're after lunch or a late-night feed.

The menu stays true to Gatsby tradition with perfectly seasoned fillings, fresh sauces, and that essential hot-chips-inside-the-roll combo that makes this Western Cape staple so addictive. Portions are generous without being wasteful, and the casual vibe means you can rock up as you are. It's straightforward food done right, perfect for when you want something filling and flavourful without any fuss.
